Here are the step-by-step solutions to the problems:

**[id 220]** 
Carmen spent $3 \times 10 = 30$ minutes on crosswords and $8 \times 5 = 40$ minutes on sudokus. Total time = $30 + 40 = 70$ minutes.

**[id 221]** 
The tank had 120 liters. Celine used 90 liters, leaving $120 - 90 = 30$ liters. She collected twice that amount in rainwater, which is $30 \times 2 = 60$ liters. Total water now = $30 + 60 = 90$ liters.

**[id 222]** 
Andy plants 90 geraniums. He plants 40 fewer petunias, so $90 - 40 = 50$ petunias. Total flowers = $90 + 50 = 140$.

**[id 223]** 
The first year, they spent $15000. The second year, they spent $15000 / 3 = 5000$. Total = $15000 + 5000 = 20000$.

**[id 224]** 
Carlos pays $30 \times 3 = 90$. Benji pays $18 \times 5 = 90$. Total = $90 + 90 = 180$.

**[id 225]** 
Traveling by bus takes 6 days. Traveling by car takes half as many days, so $6 / 2 = 3$ days. Total trip = $6 + 3 = 9$ days.

**[id 226]** 
James initially has 30 fire, 20 grass, and 40 water. After losing 8 water cards, he has 32 water. After buying 14 grass cards, he has 34 grass. He still has 30 fire. Total cards = $30 + 34 + 32 = 96$. The percentage of water cards is $32 / 96 = 1/3 = 33.33\%$. Rounded to the nearest integer, it is 33.

**[id 227]** 
Chad's total cost is $6.50 + $2.00 (meat) + $1.00 (cheese) + $1.00 (avocado) + 2 $\times$ $0.25 (sauces) + $3.00 (upgrade) = $14.00. Using a $5.00 gift card leaves $14.00 - $5.00 = 9$.

**[id 228]** 
Kalinda places 4 pieces per minute. Her mom places $4 / 2 = 2$ pieces per minute. Together they place $4 + 2 = 6$ pieces per minute. A 360-piece puzzle will take them $360 / 6 = 60$ minutes, which is exactly 1 hour.

**[id 229]** 
30% of 120 watermelons is $120 \times 0.30 = 36$. After Ashlyn harvests them, $120 - 36 = 84$ remain. Later, she harvests 3/4 of the remaining, leaving 1/4 still not ready. $84 \times (1/4) = 21$.
